Rafael —

Thanks for flagging. Accounting prefers issuing a credit memo rather than an internal journal offset when the customer requests it explicitly — it preserves the audit trail and the AR workflow. Proposed steps:

1) Finance drafts Credit Memo CM-3471 referencing original invoice INV-2098. Post credit to AR (Customer: Atlas Dynamics) to reduce outstanding balance.
2) Use contra-revenue account: "Contra-Revenue - Promotional Allowances" (GLA 4205).
3) Reverse sales tax on the credit memo line item to mirror the original invoice tax treatment; tax team will handle the tax reversal code.
4) If invoice has already been paid and customer prefers a cash refund, initiate refund workflow; otherwise AR credit will clear outstanding invoice.
5) We will route Draft_Credit_Memo_Atlas_3471.pdf to Stefan (tax) for sign-off if necessary.

I've attached a draft credit memo and a short checklist for posting. If Ops can confirm Atlas wants an offset (not refund), we'll finalize and post. Can we target posting by EOD Wed 08/25 to meet their month-end?
